programmes.d: A stacked show tonight, with clowning legend Emmett Kelly, a musical performance from The Jackson 5

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: On this episode, invisible dogs run amok in an obedience class, while insurance agent Carol pesters doctor Tim while he's on the job.
Johnny isn't interested in what Charles Grodin has to say, but you might be. B.B. King and Amy Yasbeck also grace the couch.
Tim Conway vill make you (and Lyle) laff as a tough German interrogator in WWII. Meanwhile, Carol plays a housewife listening to a radio advice show where the dilemmas addressed seem very familiar...

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Carol salutes MGM with the help of guest stars Chita Rivera and Bob Newhart.

Guest stars are everywhere! Ruth Buzzi joins Carol in the audience, Burt Reynolds shows up for the Q&A, and John Davidson takes part in a salute to classic movies from MGM, including "National Velvet."
Johnny marks the 50th anniversary of Spam in his monologue and Shelly Long opens up about leaving Cheers. Bob Nelson and Liv Ullman also appear.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tonight's episode features another installment of 'The Family', with Eunice and Ed suffering through Mama's recuperation after an accident
Johnny gives questionable amounts of respect to Rodney Dangerfield, then reasonable amounts of respect to Dom Deluise, Orson Bean, and Mariette Hartley.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: This episode is highlighted by Harvey's belated Emmy Award acceptance speech, and a Nostalgia Theatre presentation of the WWII-set 'Hollywood Canteen'
Paul Lynde and Nanette Fabray join in the fun on a series of commercial outtakes! Also, "Carol & Sis" finds Carol filling in for Roger's secretary--with the results you might expect.
Tonight's episode is for film buffs! Carol plays a housewife obsessed with celebrity gossip, much to Harvey's chagrin. Then, a take-off on an award-winning Hitchcock classic with "Rebecky."

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: A pair of grand opera voices, in the form of Eileen Farrell and Marilyn Horne, join Carol tonight
Cass Elliot and Tim Conway guest star! Mama Cass and Carol browse some intimate literature at a book shop, and Tim is an odd substitute for Marlon Brando in a community theatre-themed "Carol & Sis."
A laugh-filled "Family Show!" Sketches include an encounter at a bar between Harvey and Carol, who misreads every situation, and Carol and Vicki as contestants in a "Lucky Lady" contest.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Petula Clark, Little Anthony and the Imperials, Jackie Vernon, Bobby Vinton, Les Marcellis, and Sergio Franchi & Elizabeth Allen.

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Buddy Hackett, Rosemary Clooney, and David Steinberg.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: The one-of-a-kind Dom DeLuise and the sultry Peggy Lee are Carol's guests for a night of sketches and songs
You'll love Lucy when she gets a surprise visitor on The Tonight Show. You might also love Dom Deluise and Charlton Heston in this star-studded episode.
Comic actor John Ritter whines about doing commercials, being student body president at Hollywood High, and getting his star on The Walk-of-Fame.
Guest star Steve Lawrence is your MC for a roast of faded star Nora Desmond. And in "Carol & Sis", Vicki attempts to sober up a tipsy Carol after a bridge club meeting before Harvey returns home.
Sid Caesar and Barbara McNair are Carol's guests tonight. McNair and Carol spoof a classic TV series with "I Try", while "V.I.P." features a talk with silent film stars played by Carol and Sid.
In this episode, Mama, Eunice, and Ed return from an inspiring Sunday sermon--but struggle to maintain a feeling of "brotherly love." Also: Carol and Harvey are a couple sharing "Bedtime Honesty."
Saturday Night Live's Jon Lovitz talks growing up in The Valley and living in New York. Plus, Paul Sorvino stops by and Abbe Jaye shows off her talents as a nose flutist.

programmes.d: Tonight's episode features 'Carol & Sis', where hypochondriac Harvey must avoid an ailing Carol,

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Johnny Mathis, The Lennon Sisters, John Davidson, Jeannie C. Riley, Minnie Pearl, Shirley Jones, Herschel Bernardi, and Mama Cass Elliot.
Patrick Swayze discusses Dirty Dancing, plus Johnny interviews A. Whitney Brown and Alexandra Paul.
Broadway legend Gwen Verdon and Pat Boone are Carol's guests in this episode, which features the pair in an installment of "As The Stomach Turns." Also: Carol plays a stage actress battling the flu.

Eydie Gorme and Tim Conway guest, with Tim in a spy spoof that's comedy double-0 heaven: "Dr. Nose." Elsewhere, Eydie leads a production number about a newborn baby (with Carol as his jealous sister.)
George Carlin doesn't feel great, but he looks great! Mark Harmon is a big Carlin fan, and Johnny feels left out.
The season finale "Family Show" features Carol putting the rest of the cast on the spot for the Q&A, as well as beloved recurring sketches like "Carol & Sis" and "The Old Folks."
Guest Tim Conway breaks up Harvey in one of the series' all-time funniest sketches: "The Dentist." Also: jealous understudy Carol looks to steal the show from a Broadway star (guest Ethel Merman.)
A performance by the great Ray Charles is a highlight of this episode, which also features guest Tim Conway up to his usual tricks, including a sketch with Harvey where they play billboard hangers.
Rock Hudson joins the fun tonight, playing a man on the prowl for the ladies in a bar. Elsewhere, Tim is a television announcer whose microphones are being worked on mid-announcement.
Tonight, Mr. Tudball tries to implement an office fire safety program with Mrs. Wiggins. Also: a desert oasis with a bar might be salvation for a stranded Harvey and Tim...or is it just a mirage?
